To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the addition of wheat straw fibres in polypropylene increased the tensile modulus and strength of the composites.
wheat straw fibres can be used to reinforce PP.
the mechanical properties of PP composites can be improved by adding silane treated wheat straw fibres.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the mechanical properties of polypropylene composites with wheat straw fibres.
the mechanical, thermal and viscoelastic properties of the PP/wheat straw composites and the effects of silane treatment and nano-clay addition on these properties.
the development of new materials based on polypropylene reinforced by wheat straw fibres.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the use of silane-treated wheat straw fibres in polypropylene matrix can lead to the production of a composite material with enhanced mechanical properties, which can be further enhanced by the addition of a suitable filler such as nano-clay.
the addition of wheat straw fibres to polypropylene improves its mechanical, thermal and visco-elastic properties.
by the use of treated fibres, better adhesion at the fibre–matrix interface was obtained.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the addition of wheat straw fibres to PP increases the tensile strength, but the addition of nano- clay reduces the mechanical properties of PP composites.
the addition of wheat straw fibres to polypropylene matrix is an excellent way to improve the properties of the polymer and to reduce its cost.
the mechanical properties of PP/wheat straw composites can be improved by increasing fibre content and/or by the use of nano-clay.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the use of wheat straw fibres in polypropylene composites is possible, but the fibre treatment and the amount of fibres used are critical parameters for the mechanical performance of the composites.
the mechanical properties of PP can be enhanced by adding fibres, but the effect of the addition of nano- clay is not as significant as the fibre addition.
by the use of silane-treated wheat straw fibres, the tensile strength and tensile modulus of the composite can be improved.
